tips.text: Cast Dance of Arrows to dash in and out of fights. It resets your basic attack timer, so attack right after it.
Cast Wolf's Frenzy first, then use Dance of Arrows inside it. Dance of Arrows then comes back much sooner.
Stay inside the Wolf's Frenzy area. If you walk out of it, Wolf stops attacking right away.
Use Mounting Dread to get the enemy slowed, then attack them three times to make Wolf pounce.
Keep moving while you clear camps. Moving builds up Wolf's Frenzy's heal, and your next attack then heals you.
Take the Hunts Wolf marks on jungle camps, and pick enemy champion Hunts you can finish. Each one makes your abilities stronger for good.
Let your team start big fights. Then use Lamb's Respite on your fighting allies so nobody dies while the blessing lasts.
Step into Lamb's Respite yourself when you're low. You can't die inside it, and you get healed when it ends.

combos.name: Attack reset Q
combos.when: Trading or kiting in a fight when your attack speed is still low.
combos.text: Dance of Arrows resets your basic attack timer. Attack, dash with Q, then attack again straight away to fit in an extra hit.

tips.text: Stay out of long fights with Aatrox; he heals from the damage he deals, so hit him with Dance of Arrows and step away instead of trading.
Slow Aatrox with Mounting Dread when he chases you, then finish your third attack to land the pounce while you back away.
Watch his The Darkin Blade and step out of the marked ground. Use Dance of Arrows to dash away from the hit zones.
Walk to the side or toward Aatrox to escape Infernal Chains before it pulls you back.
Do not rely on Lamb's Respite against Aatrox in a fight, because he can stay inside the zone as well.
Stay out of melee range when you can; Ambessa wins short close fights, so keep your range and kite her with Mounting Dread to slow her.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Ambessa dives your team, so your carry survives her Public Execution damage.
Ambessa's Lacerate slows heavily, so do not dash into her chain spin with Dance of Arrows. Dash only after it is spent.
Do not attack Ambessa while she braces with Repudiation; her shield absorbs your damage and makes her slam hit harder.
Place Wolf's Frenzy over a fight or camp you will hold, but stay inside it. Wolf's Frenzy ends if you leave the area.
Stay behind minions and keep moving when Amumu is near. Bandage Toss stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way can block it.
Don't stand close to your allies when Amumu has Curse of the Sad Mummy ready. A stunned Kindred dies quickly.
Wolf's Frenzy lets you fight Amumu inside the area. Dance of Arrows has a short cooldown there, so keep kiting.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Amumu while you back away. Avoid fighting him up close, because Despair hurts more the longer you stay near.
Keep Mounting Dread for Bel'Veth when she dashes in. It slows her and sets up Wolf's pounce on your third attack.
Stay away from Above and Below. It knocks you up and slows you, and she can dash straight back in afterward.
Use Dance of Arrows to dash away when she dives. Stay near your team, because you're fragile and she's strong in a short fight.
Cast Lamb's Respite when your team is fighting her and someone would die. Bel'Veth can't finish anyone inside it.
Don't die near her. Each champion kill she gets adds permanent Lavender attack speed and a Void Coral for Endless Banquet.
Sidestep Brand's Sear and Pillar of Flame; his combo can't start until one lands.
Use Dance of Arrows to dash out when Brand has you ablaze, before Sear can stun you.
Stay away from your teammates when Brand casts Pyroclasm; it bounces between enemies and starts slowly, so you can react.
Use Lamb's Respite when Brand lands his full combo on your team; it stops you dying and heals when it ends.
Keep Mounting Dread ready for when Briar leaps in; it slows her, and three attacks on her bring Wolf in for a pounce.
Briar is forced to attack the nearest enemy during Blood Frenzy, so step away with Dance of Arrows and make her chase you.
Don't stand in Briar's Chilling Scream path at full charge; if it throws you into a wall, you take heavy damage and are stunned.
Her bleed heals her, so burst her down quickly rather than trading slowly.
Use Lamb's Respite when Briar dives your team; she can't kill anyone inside it, and everyone inside heals when it ends.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. Being pulled in leaves you slowed next to Darius with nowhere to go.
Use Mounting Dread on Darius as he closes in, and keep hitting him while backing away. His Crippling Strike slow is why you shouldn't let him reach you.
Use Dance of Arrows to hop away once Darius has spent Apprehend. He is easy to poke while that is on cooldown.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself when Darius goes for Noxian Guillotine. You can't die inside it, so the execute is wasted.
Dodge Crescent Strike. If you are marked with Moonlight, move away, because Lunar Rush will dash to you and refresh.
Use Dance of Arrows to vault away when Diana dashes in. Stay near Wolf's Frenzy so it comes back quickly.
Slow Diana with Mounting Dread when she dashes in without a way back out, then fight her.
Stay away from Diana while her Pale Cascade shield is up. Engage once it fades.
Keep your distance from Diana at level 6, because Moonfall pulls you in and slows you. Save Lamb's Respite for it.
Stay out of Dr. Mundo's reach and kite him, using Dance of Arrows to dash away while you keep shooting.
Mounting Dread slows him, but Goes Where He Pleases can resist it once. Spend a cheap slow first, then use your real fight tools.
Step on his dropped canister to destroy it. That denies his heal and keeps his passive on cooldown.
Don't stand next to him during Heart Zapper. His recast heals more if it hits you.
Use Lamb's Respite when he dives your team, so your allies can't die while the blessing lasts.
Use Mounting Dread on Ekko when he dashes in; the slow keeps him close, and your third attack makes Wolf pounce on him.
Ekko's stun zone is slow to arm and shows an image first. Stay out of the area and make him miss it.
Hit Ekko hard while Chronobreak is on cooldown; his escape and heal are gone, so he is easier to kill.
Use Dance of Arrows to dodge Timewinder, and avoid the second hit when it returns to Ekko.
Cast Lamb's Respite on your team in a fight so nobody dies. Ekko's Chronobreak still heals him, but it won't save him if you keep the pressure on.
Hit Evelynn with Mounting Dread when she dives in; it slows her and sets up the Wolf pounce.
Dance of Arrows is your escape. When the arrow on Allure points at you, stay near allies and keep it ready.
Use Lamb's Respite when Evelynn goes for Last Caress; it stops the burst from killing anyone inside.
Evelynn can hide in Demon Shade, so ward your camps and look for her before you walk into the jungle.
Keep moving and watch brush and still scarecrows. Fiddlesticks can fear you with no warning, and then you can't kite.
Stay out of Reap's range. Being slowed and silenced stops Dance of Arrows, your main escape.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Fiddlesticks channels Crowstorm on your team. It keeps allies alive through the damage.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Fiddlesticks when he closes in. Then use Dance of Arrows to get away.
Stay away from Graves when Quickdraw is ready; his dash into point-blank shots hurts a fragile marksman.
Step out of Smoke Screen quickly; leaving it removes the slow and the vision loss right away.
Slow Graves with Mounting Dread when he dashes in, then keep your distance to fight him.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself when Graves bursts you, so you cannot die while it lasts.
Use Mounting Dread on Gwen before she gets close; she is slowed, and your third attack makes Wolf pounce on her.
Don't waste Wolf's Frenzy chasing Gwen while she stands in Hallowed Mist; enemies outside it can't target her.
Wait for Gwen to leave her Hallowed Mist; the mist follows her only once, then it fades.
Use Dance of Arrows to dash out of Gwen's Needlework line; she needs to hit something to keep recasting.
Save Lamb's Respite for a fight where Gwen's team is about to burst your carry; it keeps allies alive inside.
Stay at range and kite. Hecarim wants to run you down, and you are the squishier one.
Slow Hecarim with Mounting Dread when he charges in. Keep hitting him so Wolf pounces.
Use Dance of Arrows to vault away from his Devastating Charge. Don't stand still when it comes.
Don't fight inside Spirit of Dread for long. It damages you and heals him.
Keep Lamb's Respite for when Onslaught of Shadows lands and your team is in danger. Stand clear of its fear if you can.
Ivern's Rootcaller is a straight line that stops at the first enemy it hits. Walk behind a minion or ally, or use Dance of Arrows to dodge it.
Avoid fighting Ivern alone while Daisy! is out; wait for her to expire or for allies to join you.
Hunt him down when Daisy! is on cooldown, since he has few ways to escape once he is slowed by Mounting Dread.
Ivern's Brushmaker brush lasts a long time and hides ambushes. Check it before you walk through, and use Wolf's Frenzy to look ahead.
Contest his camps. While he channels Friend of the Forest he can't act, and damage or crowd control interrupts it, so he loses the camp.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike knocks up everyone in that path.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready for when Jarvan leaps in with Cataclysm. Dash out before he lands, or you are stuck in the arena.
Use Mounting Dread on Jarvan when he closes in. It slows him so you can back away.
Save Lamb's Respite for his dive on you or your carry. Stay inside it so nobody dies while the fight plays out.
Kite Jax with Dance of Arrows and keep your distance. He wins long fights because his attacks speed up the longer he keeps hitting.
Do not attack Jax while Counter Strike is up. It dodges your basic attacks, then he stuns you when it ends, so wait it out.
Slow Jax with Mounting Dread when he jumps in, so you can get away from him.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Jax dives your team. It keeps your allies and you from dying while he is in the zone.
Stay away from Jayce's Thundering Blow range. It roots you and knocks you back, which can leave you stuck in a losing fight.
Use Mounting Dread on Jayce when he leaps in, to slow him. Then hit him three times so Wolf pounces.
Jayce is strong early, so play safe until you have some Hunts done. Pick a Hunt you can reach safely.
Dodge Shock Blast and keep your distance. After Jayce uses it, he is open to your Dance of Arrows.
Fight Jayce inside Wolf's Frenzy. Your Dance of Arrows has a shorter cooldown there, and Jayce has to take Wolf's bites.
Stay out of Wall of Pain; it slows you and cuts your Magic Resist, which makes you easy to hit.
Stand next to minions or monsters so Lay Waste hits more than one target and loses its double damage.
Dash in with Dance of Arrows to dodge his Lay Waste, then punish him; Karthus is slow and has no escape.
Keep your health up so Requiem cannot kill you. Use Lamb's Respite to protect you and your team when it lands.
After you kill Karthus, move away from his corpse; he can keep casting for a short time.
Hit Kayn with Mounting Dread when he dives. The slow and your attacks set up Wolf's pounce.
Watch for the warning on the terrain edge when Kayn uses Shadow Step. He is probably coming for you, so stay near allies.
Dodge Blade's Reach. Without it Kayn has to be close to use Umbral Trespass.
Use Dance of Arrows to hop away from Kayn's dash, then shoot back from range.
Cast Lamb's Respite when Kayn bursts out of Umbral Trespass, so you and your allies can't die from it.
Stay near minions or allies so Kha'Zix cannot get the extra damage from Taste Their Fear on you.
Once Kha'Zix has used Leap, he cannot jump in again for a while; that is your moment to fight him.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Kha'Zix when he closes in, then back away and keep attacking.
Cast Lamb's Respite when Kha'Zix dives you or an ally; it stops everyone inside from dying while he is committed.
Drop Wolf's Frenzy on your position and fight inside it, so Wolf bites Kha'Zix as he jumps in.
Lee Sin needs his abilities to land to chain together. Stay back from Sonic Wave and use Dance of Arrows to dodge his dash.
Stay spread out from your team so one Dragon's Rage kick can't knock several allies up.
Use Mounting Dread on Lee Sin when he runs in. It slows him and your hits then bring Wolf in.
Lee Sin takes magic damage badly, so use Wolf's Frenzy on him; its bites are magic.
Cast Lamb's Respite on your team when Lee Sin dives you. Nobody inside can die while it lasts.
Use Mounting Dread on Lillia when she runs at you; the slow keeps her close, and your third attack makes Wolf pounce.
Dance of Arrows lets you dash away from Watch Out! Eep! just before it lands; its centre hits hardest, so don't stand in it.
Stay out of a straight line with Lillia when she throws Swirlseed. It rolls until it hits something, so step aside.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Lillia puts your team to sleep with Lilting Lullaby. Your allies can't die while inside it.
Kite Master Yi with Dance of Arrows and Mounting Dread. Keep your distance, since he will kill you if he reaches you.
Don't rely on Mounting Dread's slow once he activates Highlander. He becomes immune to slows, so use your distance instead.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready as an escape. Use it to dash away when Master Yi lands on you with Alpha Strike.
Keep hitting Master Yi while he heals with Meditate. He needs mana to keep it going, so wear that down.
Kite Wukong with Dance of Arrows, and dash away the moment he jumps on you with Nimbus Strike.
After Wukong dashes in, wait a moment before using abilities; the clone from Warrior Trickster may be what you see.
Use Mounting Dread to keep Wukong slowed as he approaches, and stay out of reach of Cyclone, which knocks you up.
Cast Lamb's Respite when Wukong dives your team; he can't finish anyone inside it.
Avoid long fights with Wukong; his Stone Skin gets tougher the longer he keeps hitting you.
Use Mounting Dread on Naafiri when she dives in; the slow gives you time to back away from her short burst.
Hold Lamb's Respite for when Naafiri commits with Hounds' Pursuit on you or a teammate; nobody inside can die until it ends.
Dash away with Dance of Arrows after she lands on you, then shoot her and her packmates as you go.
Stay at long range and kite; Naafiri is fragile once her dashes are spent, so punish her while Eviscerate is down.
Stay out of Nidalee's long Javelin Toss line; sidestep it with Dance of Arrows, since it hurts most from far away.
Save Dance of Arrows for when Nidalee jumps in as a cougar; vault away, then fight back.
Use Mounting Dread on Nidalee when she dives so she is slowed and can't easily chase you.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself and allies when Nidalee goes for a kill; she can't finish anyone inside it.
Watch the brush for Bushwhack traps before walking through; they are invisible, so avoid brush paths Nidalee likely trapped.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready to jump away when Nocturne dashes in; he wants to reach you.
Slow Nocturne with Mounting Dread when he runs at you, and stay near your team when Paranoia is cast.
Do not waste Dance of Arrows on his Shroud of Darkness; wait until the shield is gone.
Use Lamb's Respite when Nocturne lands on you or an ally, so the target survives his attack.
Dodge Biggest Snowball Ever! with a sharp turn or a dash from Dance of Arrows, not by running straight away.
Stay out of range of Snowball Barrage's blast, or you get slowed and then rooted. Move away once you are hit.
Use Mounting Dread on Nunu to slow him as he rolls in, then back away while kiting him.
Leave Absolute Zero's area right away, since it slows more the longer you stay. Dance of Arrows can get you out.
Contest the camps Nunu is clearing; Consume takes monsters fast, so you can't win a long invade against him.
Keep your distance from Pantheon and kite him; Dance of Arrows lets you vault away after he commits.
Watch for Shield Vault; you are stunned and he wins the trade. Stay near teammates or a place to escape.
Do not attack Pantheon head-on while he braces with Aegis Assault; hit him from behind or wait.
Slow Pantheon with Mounting Dread when he jumps in, so he cannot chase you down.
Stay healthy; when Kindred is low, Comet Spear hurts a lot. Use Lamb's Respite to survive his dive.
Cast Mounting Dread on Qiyana to slow her, then hit her twice more so Wolf pounces. She is an assassin and dies fast once you land it.
Save Lamb's Respite for her Supreme Display of Talent. Stand inside the zone with your team so nobody dies to the stun burst.
Qiyana jumps in with Audacity to reach you. Keep Dance of Arrows ready to vault away and shoot back.
Use Wolf's Frenzy on the river or brush she fights in. Wolf hits her while you stay on the edge of the fight.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready to jump away when Rammus rolls at you. Powerball stops on the first enemy it hits.
Stay away from Rammus when you can. His Frenzying Taunt forces you to attack him instead of fighting back.
Don't attack Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up, since it hits you back and he is very tanky. Hit him when it is off.
Use Lamb's Respite to keep your team alive when Rammus and his team dive in. It stops allies from dying inside it.
Move around between attacks while jungling; Wolf's Frenzy heals you through its passive, and Rek'Sai's Tremor Sense reveals you only when you move.
Use Mounting Dread on Rek'Sai when she dives in, so she is slowed and you can finish her with your attacks.
Keep Lamb's Respite for when Rek'Sai uses Void Rush on you or a teammate; she can't kill anyone inside it.
Use Dance of Arrows to dash away after Rek'Sai knocks you up, or to get out of range before she builds full Fury.
Stay away from Rek'Sai's Furious Bite when her Fury is full; it turns into true damage.
Stay out of brush and keep your distance; Rengar leaps from it with Unseen Predator and can jump on you from far away.
Save Dance of Arrows to escape once Rengar leaps onto you, or if Bola Strike slows you.
Watch for the marker over you when Rengar uses Thrill of the Hunt; he is close, so ready Mounting Dread and your escape.
Fight Rengar when his Ferocity is low; an empowered Bola Strike roots, and an empowered Battle Roar cleanses him.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself and your team when Rengar dives, so he cannot finish anyone.
Stay out of a straight line from Sejuani so Glacial Prison misses you; it stops on the first champion it hits.
Do not slow Sejuani with Mounting Dread when she has Frost Armor; she is immune to slows then.
Use Dance of Arrows to hop away from Arctic Assault, and keep your distance when she is near her melee allies.
Cast Lamb's Respite on your team when Sejuani's stun lands on an ally in a fight; it keeps them alive until it ends.
Watch for Shaco going invisible. Back away from your team's weak points and hold Dance of Arrows so you can dash out of his reach.
Use Mounting Dread on Shaco when he appears; it slows him so he struggles to stay behind you.
Hit the Hallucinate clone from range; it explodes when it dies. Don't stand next to it when it dies.
Avoid walking through bushes and camps you haven't checked. Shaco's Jack In The Box is hidden and will fear and root you.
Keep your distance from Shyvana. She gets strong from hitting you, so poke her with attacks and don't trade in melee.
Use Mounting Dread early to slow Shyvana, then keep attacking her from range.
Save Dance of Arrows to dash away when Shyvana comes in with Dragon's Descent.
Hit Shyvana while her Dragon Fury is low; she can't transform until it is full.
Cast Lamb's Respite when you and your allies are inside a Shyvana fight; nobody inside can die.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready to dash away from Skarner's charge. Once he grabs you, you cannot escape.
Stay away from walls when Skarner charges at you; hitting one with him stuns you.
Stay out of Impale's reach and keep your dash for it; being suppressed usually gets you killed.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Skarner and kite him; he has to stick to you to do his damage.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Skarner dives your team; it keeps allies alive while he fights.
Use Mounting Dread on Sylas to slow him, then land your attacks on him; the third one makes Wolf pounce.
Don't stand in Sylas's reach when Abduct is ready; it stuns and pulls him onto you. Keep a camp or wall between you.
Keep Lamb's Respite for a big fight. Sylas cannot kill anyone inside it, and it heals everyone in it when it ends.
Finish Sylas fast when he is low. Kingslayer heals him more when he is hurt, so burst him before he lunges.
Hold Dance of Arrows to dash away after Sylas commits his chains. Dashing into Wolf's Frenzy also shortens its cooldown.
Stay close to your team and keep Dance of Arrows ready to vault away when Talon jumps in.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself when Talon bursts you; he cannot kill you while you stand in it.
Talon can slip away with Shadow Assault. Do not chase him blindly when he turns invisible.
Use Mounting Dread on Talon to slow him when he comes in, then keep attacking to land the pounce.
Talon can vault walls with Assassin's Path to reach you, so keep track of where he is and do not stand alone near thin walls.
Do not fight Trundle inside his Frozen Domain; pull the fight outside the ice.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly, since it slows you heavily. Dance of Arrows can vault you out.
Stay out of his reach early; Chomp lowers your Attack Damage and slows you.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Trundle and kite him from range.
Cast Lamb's Respite when Trundle dives your team; his Subjugate cannot kill anyone inside.
Keep your distance from Udyr; he has few ranged options. Shoot with Dance of Arrows and back away.
Slow Udyr with Mounting Dread as he runs at you, and keep hitting him while you retreat.
Save Dance of Arrows to dash away when he pounces; his stun can only hit you once in a while.
Place Wolf's Frenzy on the ground where Udyr must fight you; stay inside it, because it ends if you leave.
Cast Lamb's Respite in a fight that goes badly; allies inside can't die while it lasts.
Stay out of a fully charged Vault Breaker's line; if you see Vi start charging, step sideways or back off.
Do not trade punches for long. Vi's third hit shreds your Armor and speeds her up, so use Dance of Arrows to hop out of the brawl.
Slow Vi with Mounting Dread when she dives in, then back away and keep hitting her from range.
Vi's Cease and Desist cannot be stopped once it starts. Keep Dance of Arrows ready for after her dash, not during it.
If Vi dives on you in a fight, cast Lamb's Respite on yourself and your allies so nobody dies while she is on top of you.
Use Mounting Dread on Viego when he tries to jump on you; it leaves him slowed and easier to kite.
Stay out of a fight where Viego has just killed someone; he can possess the fallen champion and gain their abilities. Hit him before he reaches the wraith.
Keep Lamb's Respite for a fight that is going badly. Viego can't kill anyone inside it, and your team heals when it ends.
Dash away with Dance of Arrows when Viego charges Spectral Maw. It is a straight shot that stops at the first enemy it hits, so you can sidestep it.
Keep Dance of Arrows ready for when Volibear runs at you. Vault away so he can't reach you with Thundering Smash's stun.
Slow Volibear with Mounting Dread when he charges in. It buys you room to kite him.
Use Lamb's Respite when Volibear dives your team. Nobody inside can die until it ends.
Stay clear of Sky Splitter's marked ground when you see Volibear cast it. It slows you and hits hard.
Keep your distance from Warwick and save Dance of Arrows to dash away, though a held Jaws of the Beast can still follow you.
Stay healthy; Warwick hunts low health targets with Blood Hunt and heals when he is hurt.
Cast Mounting Dread on Warwick as he approaches; it leaves him slowed and gives you room to back off.
Use Lamb's Respite on yourself if Warwick ultimates you; it keeps you from dying while he channels.
Kite Xin Zhao with Dance of Arrows and keep your distance. Once Three Talon Strike lands its third attack, he knocks you up.
Use Mounting Dread on Xin Zhao as he charges in. The slow gives you time to back away from him.
Stay spread from your team, or away from Xin Zhao, until he has used Crescent Guard. Its knockback and damage hurt a fragile Kindred badly.
Place Wolf's Frenzy where Xin Zhao has to fight. Dance of Arrows then has a short cooldown while you stand inside it.
Cast Lamb's Respite when Xin Zhao dives your team. Anyone inside cannot die, so his burst is wasted.
Stay out of Zac's reach when he charges Elastic Slingshot; being knocked up and stunned there is deadly for you.
Step on the goo Zac sheds to destroy it and stop his healing.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Zac and kite him with Dance of Arrows; he has to close the gap to hurt you.
When Zac splits into bloblets, kill them all so he cannot come back.
Save Lamb's Respite for when Zac dives your team; it keeps allies alive while it lasts.
Cast Lamb's Respite on yourself when Death Mark is on you; you cannot die while inside it, so the mark's burst cannot kill you.
Stay close to your team when Zed is around. He wants to catch you alone, and Kindred is fragile.
Use Mounting Dread on Zed as he dives in; it slows him, and your third attack makes Wolf pounce.
Dance of Arrows lets you dash away after Zed swaps to his shadow. Use it to leave his reach.
Drop Wolf's Frenzy on yourself when Zed jumps on you, so Wolf bites him and your Dance of Arrows comes back sooner.
Stay out of Grasping Roots range, and sidestep it; Kindred is fragile and a root usually means she dies.
Step on Zyra's seeds before she grows them, and dodge back at the last moment if she casts at them as you step.
Use Dance of Arrows to dash out of the delayed Deadly Spines, not toward it.
Zyra's plants have fixed, low health and expire fast. Move the fight away from her seeds, or close in when she plants too far from herself.
Use Mounting Dread to slow Zyra when she is exposed, so her plants cannot protect her.
